archive librarian of a dead language, alt-history, rendered as cel-shaded concept art moodboard, a punchy saturated candy palette, wet terrazzo

STAGE 2 — one panel per turnaround angle. Design lock text is restated in every panel prompt.

Never copy a specific person or a copyrighted character from the moodboard — take palette, mood and material language only.

Grade target: a pastel low-contrast grade with a lifted black point. Lighting reference: split gel lighting, teal on the shadow side and magenta on the key side.

Return the design lock as one dense paragraph, no headings, no commentary.
